input: The limitation runs across these examples. Cursor and GitHub establish their own announcements, not independent effectiveness. Willison describes his own app without a controlled comparison or complete accounting of effort. First-time users, accessibility users, and unsuccessful small-project attempts remain insufficiently represented. So assess these developments separately: supervision, secret checking, and diagnosis. Their practical value depends on whether you can inspect the resulting work and use the relevant check—not whether they share an agent label.
